scope: Design research, not a systematic review; primary papers, standards, official product docs, and inspected local SN9 evidence. Educational findings are context dependent.

sources.title: IES: Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
sources.finding: Supports spaced review, worked examples alternating with problems, coordinated words and graphics, retrieval, and explanatory questions; recommendations have different evidence ratings.
sources.decision: Use predictable explain–predict–manipulate–solve–explain–revisit episodes. Timing defaults are product hypotheses, not scientifically established universal intervals.

sources.title: Freeman et al.: Active learning in STEM
sources.finding: Across 225 undergraduate STEM studies, active learning improved assessment outcomes relative to lecture. This is evidence for participation, not proof for this particular software or adult learner.
sources.decision: Require meaningful actions and novel transfer tasks; do not equate watch time or clicking with understanding.

sources.title: Bastani et al.: Generative AI Without Guardrails Can Harm Learning
sources.finding: In a high-school mathematics setting, assisted task performance and subsequent unaided learning differed; tutor design and teacher-designed hints mattered.
sources.decision: Separate coached practice from independent assessment; record hint use; preserve answer-reveal provenance; do not generalize the numerical effects to this course.

sources.title: CMU Eberly: Align assessments, objectives and instruction
sources.finding: Assessments should test the actual intended capability rather than only factual recall.
sources.decision: Each objective maps to an exercise, rubric, misconception set and transfer task. Debugging competence must be assessed by debugging.

sources.title: Microsoft Research: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.finding: The guidelines emphasize capability clarity, appropriate timing, feedback, correction and user control across initial use, normal use and failures.
sources.decision: Expose tutor context and uncertainty; explain adaptation reasons; support undo, challenge-grade and decline-detour flows.

sources.title: Harrison et al.: Practitioner-led micro-randomised trials of AI tutoring
sources.finding: Reports an encouraging curriculum-aligned result, but substantial attrition and exploratory engagement analyses limit interpretation.
sources.decision: Version teaching interventions and measure delayed transfer. Do not claim platform efficacy from engagement or a one-person pilot.

sources.title: Explorable Explanations
sources.finding: Demonstrates explanations that learners manipulate directly.
sources.decision: Build small stateful experiments with a prediction before reveal, rather than decorative animation. Inspiration only, not outcome evidence.

sources.title: Distill: Attention and Augmented Recurrent Neural Networks
sources.finding: Coordinates technical prose, diagrams and local interactions around a mechanism.
sources.decision: Keep the exact formula, tensor state, visual and code line synchronized. Create original artwork and examples.

sources.title: 3Blue1Brown: What is backpropagation really doing?
sources.finding: Builds intuition for sensitivities before more formal gradient machinery.
sources.decision: Use an original scalar computational graph before vectors and autograd. Link external lessons instead of copying them.

sources.title: Khanmigo for learners
sources.kind: Official product description; not independent efficacy evidence
sources.finding: Presents contextual, conversational tutoring as part of study.
sources.decision: Persistent episode-scoped help with hint ladders and worked-example requests; avoid treating product claims as research evidence.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2
sources.finding: Defines testable accessibility requirements including keyboard use, reflow, focus, alternatives to dragging, and accessible authentication.
sources.decision: Target AA; keyboard equivalents for graphs and tensor interactions, MathML/text alternatives, reduced motion, 44px product target, and manual screen-reader testing.

sources.title: 1EdTech QTI specification documents
sources.finding: QTI represents assessment items, tests and results, including richer portable interactions in v3.
sources.decision: Preserve stable IDs, scoring metadata and exportable item structure; scoped QTI export later, no v1 conformance claim.

sources.title: ADL xAPI data specification
sources.finding: Models learning experience statements with actor, verb, object and contextual/result information.
sources.decision: Use a versioned internal event envelope and later an explicit xAPI adapter. xAPI statements alone do not establish mastery.

sources.title: H5P package specification
sources.finding: Separates packaged content parameters from reusable interaction libraries.
sources.decision: Separate course content from registered activity renderers. H5P import is a future adapter, not the foundational runtime.

sources.title: Pyodide: Using Python in a web worker
sources.finding: Python can run away from the browser UI thread; worker boundaries require explicit message passing.
sources.decision: Use lazy browser Python for small CPU lessons, with watchdog termination and an isolated origin. A Web Worker is not a complete security or hard memory boundary.

sources.title: JupyterLite documentation
sources.finding: Supports browser-native notebook experiences, but not all full Jupyter features.
sources.decision: Offer notebook export/optional embedding later. Keep the first learning shell simpler; browser Python does not promise native MPS/PyTorch support.

sources.title: MCP authorization
sources.finding: Defines authorization for restricted MCP resources and tools.
sources.decision: Expose course context and proposals through scoped MCP tools; use protocol-compatible authorization for remote transports and scoped local capabilities.

sources.title: MCP security best practices
sources.finding: Describes threats around authorization, confused deputies and token handling.
sources.decision: Server-side scopes, no token passthrough, explicit context boundaries, and untrusted learner/source text kept out of privileged control instructions.

sources.title: Macrocosmos TAH user guide
sources.finding: TAH connects consumer computers to IOTA training; work, contributions and changing network parameters affect rewards.
sources.decision: Teach the app/network distinction and accepted work versus reward. Current payout formulas are outside fixed course claims and require dated verification.

sources.title: IOTA technical primer
sources.finding: Describes heterogeneous pipeline/data-parallel training, orchestration and merging. Some components are explicitly proposals, including CLASP in the initial release.
sources.decision: Use it for architectural context, then ground concrete worker behavior in pinned source. Never teach every paper proposal as deployed protocol.

sources.title: Macrocosmos IOTA repository
sources.finding: Public implementation and project context are available for source-based teaching.
sources.decision: Pin release/commit and file hashes for source walks. Compare the exact patched runtime to its base, not moving main.

sources.title: PyTorch autograd introduction
sources.finding: Autograd tracks differentiable operations and computes gradients through a graph.
sources.decision: Contrast forward evaluation, backward gradient accumulation and optimizer updates with executable examples.

sources.title: PyTorch 2.7 numerical accuracy
sources.finding: Floating-point computation can differ by operation order, batching and backend.
sources.decision: Teach exact versus numerical equivalence, reference errors, long trajectories, dtypes and reproducibility as separate concepts.

sources.title: Apple: Accelerated PyTorch training on Mac
sources.finding: The MPS backend connects PyTorch operations to Apple GPU acceleration.
sources.decision: Draw the Python → framework/autograd → backend → Metal/GPU stack; qualify Mac suitability rather than claiming universal superiority.

sources.title: MLX documentation
sources.finding: MLX is a separate array/ML framework designed for Apple silicon with composable transforms and unified memory support.
sources.decision: Compare execution models and interoperability costs; do not describe MLX as a PyTorch optimization flag.

sources.title: Apple: M5 and A19 GPUs
sources.finding: Discusses neural accelerators in GPU cores and ML workload acceleration.
sources.decision: Explicitly distinguish GPU neural accelerators, the separate Neural Engine and software TensorOps APIs.

sources.title: Apple: Custom ML operations with Metal tensors
sources.finding: Discusses tensor operations and requirements for chaining compatible layouts.
sources.decision: Use coordinate/layout compatibility as a low-level systems case study; tie the private incident to its measured reproduction.

sources.title: Karpathy: Neural Networks Zero to Hero
sources.finding: Uses code-first progression from gradients toward language models.
sources.decision: Borrow the progression principle, with original exercises and added distributed systems, memory and numerical correctness depth.

sources.title: micrograd
sources.finding: Shows how compact scalar reverse-mode autodiff can be.
sources.decision: A small original autodiff capstone with independent finite-difference tests; link and respect the source license if any code is later reused.

sources.title: GitHub Actions secure use reference
sources.finding: Recommends least privilege, immutable action pins, and caution around untrusted code in privileged workflows.
sources.decision: Public PR jobs have no secrets or production runners; release permissions are isolated. Do not execute fork code via privileged pull_request_target jobs.

sources.title: npm trusted publishing
sources.finding: Supports short-lived OIDC publishing and provenance in supported CI environments.
sources.decision: Use trusted publishing where supported, reproducible package manifests, and install-test the packed package before release.

sources.title: GitHub secret scanning
sources.finding: Scans supported secret patterns in repository content; it is not a complete private-data classification system.
sources.decision: Combine secret scanning with explicit private-data egress tests and publish allowlists. Public repos never fetch private course content.

sources.title: Temporal workflow message passing
sources.finding: Persistent workflows accept asynchronous signals, read queries and tracked updates.
sources.decision: One durable supervisor per enrollment, explicit side-effect activities, idempotent commits, resumable work and bounded histories. Workflow durability is not exactly-once delivery of arbitrary external effects.

sources.title: LangGraph persistence
sources.finding: Distinguishes per-thread checkpoints from cross-thread stores; in-memory checkpoints do not survive process restarts.
sources.decision: Persist learner memory independently from agent conversation checkpoints. Use one orchestration authority; avoid layering two competing durable state machines in v1.

sources.title: Microsoft Research: Learning outcomes with GenAI
sources.finding: Discusses mixed learning effects, overconfidence and the importance of deliberate pedagogical design.
sources.decision: Measure unaided transfer and confidence calibration. Do not optimize solely for answer speed, satisfaction or time spent.

sources.title: Google Research: Learn Your Way
sources.kind: 2025 product research and small study; first-party report
sources.finding: Already explores personalized examples, multiple representations, generated media and quizzes.
sources.decision: These features alone are not a novelty claim. Our differentiation must be durable evidence-linked supervision, executable verification, learner control and open course infrastructure; evaluate it.

sources.title: LearnLM: evaluation-driven educational AI
sources.finding: Develops educational evaluations in collaboration with learners and educators.
sources.decision: Maintain pedagogy evals separate from model answer accuracy and software CI. Ask domain reviewers to audit teaching and assessment quality.

sources.title: LearnLM: Improving Gemini for Learning
sources.finding: Studies pedagogical instruction following and expert preferences.
sources.decision: Treat a tutoring model as one component; expert preference is not equivalent to long-term learning outcomes or a reason to hardwire one provider.

sources.title: Open Learner Models and Learning Analytics Dashboards
sources.finding: Examines open learner models and learner-facing analytics, including learner control and sources of modeling evidence.
sources.decision: Make the profile inspectable, correctable and evidence-linked. Distinguish self-reported knowledge, observed attempts and inferred teaching hypotheses.

sources.title: Learner model techniques in adaptive e-learning
sources.finding: Surveys learner-model techniques and highlights gaps in justification for adaptation choices.
sources.decision: Start with auditable evidence states rather than uncalibrated mastery percentages; evaluate and version any later predictive model.

sources.title: Open edX course pacing and schedules
sources.finding: Distinguishes instructor pacing, suggested personalized schedules and a course end date.
sources.decision: Model suggested pacing and a binding cap as separate fields. Relative schedules need explicit anchors.

sources.title: Canvas due dates versus availability dates
sources.finding: Separates a due date from the interval during which submissions are available, and surfaces relevant time zones.
sources.decision: Separate learner target, submission cutoff, adaptive-work cutoff and material access. Show the resolved date and time zone.

sources.title: Moodle quiz settings and overrides
sources.finding: Individual/group overrides can alter dates, timing and attempt limits.
sources.decision: Provide scoped explicit overrides and a policy preview rather than hidden ad hoc exceptions. Our hard-cap hierarchy is a proposed design, not Moodle behavior.

sources.title: Moodle course completion
sources.finding: Course completion is a reporting mechanism distinct from access restriction.
sources.decision: Separate completion outcome, mastery evidence and access state; reaching a cap does not award mastery.

sources.title: Open edX course team roles
sources.finding: Defines distinct course administration/staff responsibilities and limited staff capabilities.
sources.decision: Every course gets an admin workspace with scoped roles, learner previews and audit records; administration is not automatically full access to private chats.

sources.title: W3C Timing Adjustable
sources.finding: Addresses accessibility of time limits, including adjustment/extension mechanisms and specified exceptions.
sources.decision: Review applicable interactive time limits separately from course planning dates. No default timed quizzes; accommodations are not charged to discretionary extension allowances.

sources.title: OWASP Authorization Cheat Sheet
sources.finding: Recommends deny-by-default authorization and checking permissions on every request.
sources.decision: Server-side role and scope checks protect admin actions, extensions, artifacts and agent tool commits; UI visibility is not enforcement.

sources.title: Temporal durable timers
sources.finding: Timers can persist as part of durable workflows.
sources.decision: Use durable cap/review timers plus commit-time checks; a delayed timer must never be the sole enforcement mechanism.

sources.title: Duolingo: the learning path redesign
sources.finding: Describes a linear path with practice integrated into the sequence.
sources.decision: Use one recommended next action and incorporate review in the path; do not transplant language-course efficacy claims to this product.

sources.title: Duolingo: how to use the learning path
sources.finding: Positions the path as choosing what to study and review next.
sources.decision: Keep required learning as a guided sequence; place optional resources inline and tracking behind secondary controls.

sources.title: Duolingo illustration shape language
sources.finding: Emphasizes readable silhouettes, few purposeful details, consistent visual language and scalable vector illustration.
sources.decision: Create an original, coherent technical illustration system with semantic colors and accurate motion; do not copy characters or branding.

sources.title: Duolingo core UI craft redesign
sources.finding: Discusses visual hierarchy, spacing and consistency across product surfaces.
sources.decision: Keep one learner interaction vocabulary; administration can remain a separate multi-section workspace.

sources.title: YouTube IFrame Player API
sources.finding: Provides playback state/events and documents removed/private, embedding-disabled and client-identification errors.
sources.decision: Use the official player, validate origin/identity, preserve controls and implement useful fallbacks. Playback events never prove understanding.

sources.title: YouTube Data API search
sources.finding: Supports video search filters including embeddability and captions.
sources.decision: Dedicated research worker discovers candidates; verify availability and content relevance before insertion, not just title or popularity.

sources.title: YouTube caption download permissions
sources.finding: Caption downloading requires appropriate authorization and can be forbidden.
sources.decision: Do not assume transcripts can be fetched for arbitrary videos; use permitted sources, creator transcripts or an explicit unreviewed state.

sources.title: YouTube embedding and privacy-enhanced mode
sources.finding: Describes privacy-enhanced embeds, caption parameters and embedding constraints.
sources.decision: Click-to-load privacy-enhanced players where appropriate; explain external provider behavior without promising zero tracking.

sources.title: YouTube required minimum functionality
sources.finding: Defines requirements for compliant API/player integration.
sources.decision: Keep provider attribution, links and required player behavior; do not obscure controls or treat embedding as permission to redistribute video.

sources.title: Veo generation in Gemini API
sources.finding: Documents short video generation and asynchronous job retrieval, with model-dependent features.
sources.decision: Provider-neutral video jobs with capability negotiation, budgets and validation. Compose longer explainers from supported clips when needed; verify access at implementation.

sources.title: OpenAI video generation
sources.finding: Documents asynchronous video creation, status and media retrieval.
sources.decision: Use durable media jobs and provider adapters; no assumption that a chat subscription or current session exposes a video-generation tool.

sources.title: W3C accessible audio and video content
sources.finding: Recommends planning accessible visual/audio information, readable overlays and descriptions while scripting and storyboarding.
sources.decision: Captions, transcripts, visual descriptions and text/interactive alternatives are mandatory media production outputs.

sources.title: Expo concepts and free tooling
sources.finding: Expo supports native Android/iOS and web; framework features are open source/free, hosted EAS services are separate.
sources.decision: Prefer Expo/React Native for the universal learner client; no mandatory paid build service.

sources.title: Expo native development/build workflow
sources.finding: Documents MIT tools, native projects/development builds and local or own-CI builds.
sources.decision: Build native projects from M1; Expo Go and browser resizing do not prove native readiness.

sources.title: React DOM components in Expo
sources.finding: DOM content is hosted through WebView mechanisms; ordinary native components are not arbitrary HTML elements.
sources.decision: Use explicit platform adapters and audited lab/media islands; never assume browser libraries are native-compatible.

sources.title: Expo tablet configuration
sources.finding: iOS tablet support is explicit configuration and defaults off in the documented setting.
sources.decision: Enable and test tablet support, orientations and multi-window behavior as deliberate release requirements.

sources.title: Capacitor native runtime
sources.finding: Packages web applications with native runtime/plugin integration for iOS and Android.
sources.decision: Credible fallback for web-heavy content, but webview interaction/lifecycle/native integration still require validation.

sources.title: Flutter adaptive design
sources.finding: Distinguishes fitting content to space from adapting interactions to the available space and input devices.
sources.decision: Use effective window size and input capabilities; tablets are not simply enlarged phones.

sources.title: Flutter web accessibility
sources.finding: Flutter uses a semantics-to-DOM accessibility layer for its rendered web UI.
sources.decision: Include rich text, formulas, selection, browser semantics and editor integration in the Flutter comparison; do not assume web parity.

sources.title: Android adaptive display guidance
sources.finding: Describes adapting interfaces to available display/window space.
sources.decision: Validate compact/medium/expanded windows, foldables, rotation and split-screen rather than device-name breakpoints.

sources.title: React Native accessibility
sources.finding: Provides native accessibility properties and platform-specific accessibility behavior.
sources.decision: VoiceOver/TalkBack and dynamic text acceptance supplement web WCAG tests.

sources.title: Apple App Review Guidelines
sources.finding: Addresses executable content, educational-code exceptions, native APIs, privacy and software offered outside the binary.
sources.decision: Native extension boundaries and review are first-class design constraints; compile success does not establish store approval.

sources.title: AI SDK model/tool abstraction
sources.finding: Provides TypeScript model-provider, structured-output, tool and agent interfaces.
sources.decision: Use a provider-neutral model gateway with bounded role jobs; hosting through the vendor is not required.

sources.title: Temporal AI SDK integration
sources.finding: Documents integrating model operations with durable TypeScript workflows.
sources.decision: Run nondeterministic work through durable activities and verify integration compatibility before adopting versions.

sources.title: LangGraph overview
sources.finding: Provides graph-based stateful agent orchestration.
sources.decision: Evaluate as an alternative or bounded plugin strategy; do not introduce a second competing durable authority by default.

sources.title: Pydantic AI
sources.finding: Provides typed Python agent interfaces, dependencies and tool workflows.
sources.decision: Support a Python adapter where useful; prefer one primary backend language for the initial service.

sources.title: Pydantic Evals
sources.finding: Provides code-based evaluation and custom evaluators for model/agent behavior.
sources.decision: Use optional Python evaluation adapters; learning assessment validity still requires independent references and rubrics.

sources.title: AI SDK telemetry
sources.finding: Documents OpenTelemetry integration and input/output capture controls.
sources.decision: Explicitly disable broad content capture by default; build a scoped evidence-aware debugger rather than exposing all raw prompts.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions
sources.finding: Defines evolving conventions for instrumenting generative AI systems.
sources.decision: Pin semantic-convention versions and map them into a stable domain trace schema.

sources.title: Langfuse self-hosting
sources.finding: Provides self-hostable model observability; repo license distinguishes MIT core and enterprise portions.
sources.decision: Optional MIT-core backend adapter; required admin/debug capabilities must not depend on paid enterprise features.

sources.title: Promptfoo evaluation toolkit
sources.finding: Supports systematic prompt/model evaluations and custom assertions.
sources.decision: Use for reproducible held-out tutor/agent regression runs; do not use an LLM judge as sole mathematical authority.

sources.title: Maestro mobile UI testing
sources.finding: Provides automated mobile UI flow testing.
sources.decision: Add real native lesson/placement/resume/gate journeys alongside Playwright web tests.

sources.title: Duolingo placement-test design
sources.finding: Describes adaptive placement, partial credit and the need to calibrate scoring rather than choose arbitrary values.
sources.decision: Use bounded concept-mapped diagnostics; avoid unsupported psychometric accuracy claims and validate false-skip rates.

sources.title: Open Policy Agent
sources.finding: Provides a general policy evaluation engine.
sources.decision: Candidate for organizational policy complexity; v1 can keep deterministic typed policy functions with replay/property tests.

sources.title: Framework license snapshots
sources.finding: Verified Expo/RN/RNW/Capacitor/Temporal/LangGraph/Pydantic AI/SVG MIT; Flutter BSD; AI SDK/OTel/Maestro Apache; Promptfoo MIT. Langfuse excludes enterprise paths; Phoenix is ELv2.
sources.decision: Use permissive core dependencies by default. Pin packages, inspect transitive/bundled licenses and separate optional commercial services before release.

sources.title: React Native Skia rendering and platform requirements
sources.finding: Supports demanding 2D rendering with explicit version/platform requirements.
sources.decision: Candidate dense-scene renderer; pin compatible versions and prove web/native support, not just a mocked rendering test.

sources.title: React Native Reanimated
sources.finding: Provides declarative motion, native UI-thread execution and gesture integration.
sources.decision: Use animation/gesture adapters under scene/timeline contracts; actual frame pacing and accessibility remain test requirements.

sources.title: Lottie runtime
sources.finding: Renders authored animation assets across supported runtime integrations.
sources.decision: Optional import adapter; runtime availability does not imply all authoring/export tools are free or all features match across platforms.

sources.title: Rive runtime
sources.finding: Provides artboard/state-machine animation and graphics runtime interfaces.
sources.decision: Optional authored-animation adapter; retain a complete free code/vector route and validate capability parity and asset rights.

limitations: A Nature 2025 AI tutoring paper could not be fetched because of access redirects; its reported results are not used as design evidence.
Product inspiration is not evidence of educational efficacy.
The September 2026 tutoring result is a preprint in a different educational setting.
The course has not yet been authored or evaluated; these are design decisions and testable hypotheses.
